senses.definition: (Southern US or African-American Vernacular) remote past form of be.
examples: We been knew they was doing this.

She was disloyal, Casper was disloyal, so them muthafuckas gotta go. Like you said[,] we been knew we was going to have to kill Frost, so let's do it and Light too.” Star said. “Say no more. I'ma handle Kisha myself.” Max said walking to the door.

senses.definition: (Southern US or African-American Vernacular, rare) Synonym of be (infinitival sense).
examples: It useta been five foot long.
